name: Adventure Guildsman

adventurer_guildsman/31838.htm.text: Adventure Guildsman: Welcome, my friend! Some astonishingly macabre adventures have just become available!

links.text: Listen to an explanation about the new Life Crystals.
Exchange previous Life Crystals for new Life Crystals.

adventurer_guildsman/raid_boss_position..text: Adventure Guildsman: We don't provide information about raid monsters any more. You can get the information from the Raid tab of World Info on the map.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

adventurer_guildsman/AboutNewLifeCrystal.text: Perhaps you remember that in the past, Life Crystals were assigned grades based on the strength of the monsters. That was because a Life Crystal resembles the core energy of a powerful monster, and so different cores came from monsters of different strength. However, recent research has discovered …

adventurer_guildsman/AboutHighLevelGuild.text: Adventure Guild Member: Talk to the Manager of the Adventure Guild if you want to create a higher-quality item. He only comes to the town when the Lord or Clan of the castle destroys a certain type of monster to celebrate the occasion. He's most interested in: Master Anays High Priestess van Halter…
